opening.line1: Some stories are written with words…

seed.line1: Every beautiful thing starts with something small.
seed.wateringHint: Drag the watering can over the soil — on mobile, touch & drag.

growthStages.name: Roots
growthStages.caption: Love takes root where it is cared for.

growthStages.name: Heart Leaves
growthStages.caption: Every leaf beats like a heart.

growthStages.name: Full Bloom
growthStages.caption: Look what a little love can grow.

bloom.line1: Look what a little love can grow.

memories.title: The first time we talked
memories.text: I was nervous. You laughed. And suddenly everything felt easy.
memories.message: That is when my world quietly changed direction.

memories.title: Late-night conversations
memories.text: We talked about everything and nothing until the sky went pale.
memories.message: You feel like home, even at 3am.

memories.title: That stupid joke
memories.place: Wherever we were laughing too loud
memories.text: We still laugh about it. We will always laugh about it.

memories.title: The moment I knew
memories.text: Nothing dramatic happened. I just realized you were different.
memories.message: Different in the way forever feels.

memories.title: Everything I keep
memories.text: Small moments, big feelings — all the ones I never want to forget.
memories.message: Thank you for every single one.

memoryHearts: That one stupid joke we still laugh about.
The moment I realized you were different.
The memories I never want to forget.

reasons: Because your smile feels like home.
Because you make ordinary moments special.
Because I can be completely myself with you.
Because somehow, you became my favorite person.
Because even silence is beautiful with you.
Because you believe in me on days I forget how.
Because loving you feels like breathing.
Because my future looks like you.
whyYou.gathered: Every reason gathers into one truth.

letter.pre1: There is something I couldn’t say out loud…
lines: I have rehearsed this a thousand times,
and every version still ends the same way —
with me loving you more than words allow.
You turned ordinary days into small miracles.
You made me softer, braver, kinder.
You are my calm and my adventure,
my quiet morning and my wildest dream.
If love is a garden, you are both
in every lifetime, in every universe.

nightSky.line1: If I could give you the whole world…
nightSky.line2: …I would still choose to give you my heart.

heartbeat.reveal2: That’s what happens every time I think about you.

finalJourney: There is still one thing I want you to know.

lines: And every beautiful moment that comes after.

finale.line1: No matter where life takes us…
finale.line2: A part of my heart will always belong to you.
